April 23 Mrs. Maude Brommer - Elderly - methodist - goitre - enrolled To-day. Henry Strubel - 56 - Eloise - operation for bladder trouble last Monday - telegram informs sister he is dying - Enrolled 50¢
Mrs. Isabelle Coor - 54 - breast cancers
Mrs. Pfaff - III Order - Operation last Friday - very low ....
Edw'd Fraser - 32 - Episcopelian (once studied for the ministery, now scoffer (?) - friend promises to read City of God if change is seen ..
May Ist
1940, May
Alex Dresden - 25 - very promising as wanderd away and not been heard from since last October. Was in reformitory.
Herry Grace - 48 - Methodist - had sleeping sickness 24 yrs. ago - slept at
Page 207
that time for ten weeks - feeding him at first by a tuve then with a tea-spoon - 5 & 6 times a day. Doctoring now for four yrs at Harper's
Master Wm Tigne - 13 - mentally a child of six months - Mother asks prayers for God's guidance.
Marion LaPointe 22 years, very sick (in Providence Hosp.) Drs. in doubt ... Enrolled To-day with Family .... 25.00
Cha's Weismieller - 40 - Lukemia
Mrs. Helena Pienta ... prayed for before - hopeless at that time - now much improved - another operation Tomorrow
May 8 Ralph Tembusch - 19 - sent home from Seminary on account of "nerveouw hysteria - over study - in seemingly really bad shape - I enrolled To-day ... parents promise to read "City of God" if .. ..
Page 208 May 5th Mrs. Mary Sklar - 71 - High blood
Thanks - Miss Helen Eostillo - Canida - 77 an old teacher - out of church 56 yrs; just drifted away; living with two other teachers - Methodists also retired; One of them charitably reminded some Catholic friends that she ought to be Catholic.
